_meta.what_this_is: Four service instances behind a load balancer, each with three underlying facts: alive (the process is running), deps_ok (its dependencies -- database, cache -- are reachable), and warming (it is still loading and not yet able to serve). Liveness = alive (drives restarts). Readiness = alive AND deps_ok AND NOT warming (drives routing). The fleet is built so liveness and readiness disagree on two instances -- the exact case a single 'healthy?' check gets wrong.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The instance states are hand-authored so the naive (route-by-liveness) and readiness-gated routings, the failures each produces, and the restart set are exact and checkable; every decision is computed in health.py. i0 serves; i1's dependency is down (alive, not ready); i2 is warming (alive, not ready); i3 has crashed (not alive).
